svg.title: Inside Your House by William Foteping, cover: a cutaway of a modern house with every system labeled
svg.desc: Book cover in deep forest green. The title Inside Your House and its subtitle sit at the top. A paper band across the middle holds a cutaway of a two-story house with every system named around it. At the bottom, the author name and a card with a QR code for the Keystone Home app.
